verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de exposes API endpoints for notarization, translation, incorporation, etc., but there is no evidence of any embeddable widget, iframe, or SDK for embedding a signing UI inside a third-party app or website — the evidence pack only shows backend API calls and webhook events. missing for 10: embeddable signing widget/iframe, front-end SDK or JS component, hosted signing page for embedding, customization/branding options for embedded flow.
